title: DroneTelemetry
description: Per-tick telemetry packet emitted by a drone agent (simulated in Phase 1, real MAVLink adapter in Phase 2). Owner: Chirag. Co-sign required on altitude_m, heading_deg, gimbal_pitch_deg from Atul (geolocation math consumes these directly). This schema is FROZEN for Week 1 — any change requires sign-off from both owners per Section 16 of the Team Role Distribution plan.

drone_id.description: Stable identifier for the drone agent, e.g. DRONE-01.

sector_id.description: The search sector this drone is currently assigned to, e.g. SECTOR-A.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of this telemetry sample.

altitude_m.description: Altitude above ground level, meters. Co-signed: Atul (geolocation projection math).

heading_deg.description: Drone yaw/heading, compass degrees. Co-signed: Atul.

gimbal_pitch_deg.description: Camera gimbal pitch, degrees (0 = level, -90 = straight down). Co-signed: Atul.

frame_ref.description: Reference/pointer to the frame captured at this tick (filename or storage key), NOT inline binary. Renamed from PRD's 'frame' to make explicit this is a pointer only, keeping the socket payload small.
